_doc: Ambiguity classes for overloaded language conditioning. A class groups tasks that are simultaneously executable from one scene state, so a low-specificity (L0) instruction is genuinely multimodal rather than merely vague. L0 verbs never cross primitive boundaries (no 'grasp' in the lift class) and never name a color. 'tasks' drives training labels and class-level success scoring -- the CALVIN oracle only reports tasks actually completed, so scoring the full member list can never falsely credit an unreachable one. 'eval_condition'/'feasible_modes' describe a synthetic scene in which as many members as possible are simultaneously executable; use them for the entropy ceiling and for reset when not replaying dataset scenes.

lift_block.note: Only the three table lifts are reachable: TASK_INITIAL_CONDITIONS has no drawer placement value (table/slider_left/slider_right only), and a slider condition can hold at most one block.

push_block.note: All six members share byte-identical initial conditions; genuinely 6-way multimodal.

rotate_block.note: All six members share byte-identical initial conditions; genuinely 6-way multimodal.

place_block.note: Both members require a block already in the gripper, which TASK_INITIAL_CONDITIONS does not model (see task_configs.py:275). Class-level numbers here are only meaningful once that limitation is fixed.

light_on.note: Both start off under the canonical condition; genuinely 2-way multimodal.

light_off.note: Needs a shared both-on condition. The per-task conditions turn on only one (turn_off_led is led:1/bulb:0, turn_off_lightbulb is led:0/bulb:1), which would make each state-exclusive.

specific_only.open_drawer: Starts closed; close_drawer starts open. Mutually exclusive by state.
specific_only.close_drawer: Starts open; open_drawer starts closed. Mutually exclusive by state.
specific_only.move_slider_left: Starts with slider at 'right'; only one direction is ever executable.
specific_only.move_slider_right: Starts with slider at 'left'; only one direction is ever executable.
specific_only.push_into_drawer: Starts with the block ungrasped and blue/pink in the slider, unlike both place_in_* tasks.
specific_only.stack_block: No sibling task; an ambiguous form would just be a paraphrase.
specific_only.unstack_block: No sibling task; an ambiguous form would just be a paraphrase.
